WHIZZGOLF is the first pace-of-play monitoring platform publicly available as an APP on the smartphone of the golfer and as secured WEBAPP for the club staff, without the need for additional hardware.
AS A GOLFER you get informed about your own pace of play and on the pace of play of all the flights in front of you. The challenging UTLRADRIVE format rewards you for playing more fairways in regulation, hence helps you improving your score. An electronic scorecard allows you to keep track of your score and game statistics. The hole maps give you an overview what is in front of you and provide the accurate distance to the center of the green or the flag.
GOLF OPERATIONS AND MARSHALS obtain a helicopter view of the complete course and can monitor, manage, and steer all flights and golfers remotely, without any additional hardware. Real-time communication allows them to optimize the pace-of-play on short term, during the game. Post round statistics help them to optimize the course for long-term improvements. 
EVENTS ORGANIZERS receive a single dashboard to monitor all participants and to enable real-time scoring for their events. Sponsor visibility is subtle and fully integrated in the whole platform maximizing the return on investment of the sponsors.
